sentences.8.4 Marit handler til bursdagsmiddag: 8.4 Marit shops for a birthday dinner
sentences.Marit skal feire bursdag i kveld, og noe: Marit is celebrating her birthday this evening, and some good friends are coming over.
sentences.Hun vil lage en god middag til gjestene,: She wants to make a good dinner for the guests, but first she has to go shopping.
sentences.Marit drar til butikken, og Håvard blir: Marit goes to the shop, and Håvard stays at home to tidy up and vacuum.
sentences.Han har lyst til å bake ei bursdagskake: He wants to bake a birthday cake for Marit, because she loves cakes.
sentences.Hun har ei lang handleliste, for hun ska: She has a long shopping list, because she is going to serve a three-course dinner.
sentences.Til forrett vil hun lage ei deilig, varm: For the starter she wants to make a delicious hot carrot soup with coriander.
sentences.Til hovedrett skal hun lage fårikål, og: For the main course she is going to make lamb and cabbage stew, and she wants to serve ice cream with fresh berries for dessert.
sentences.Hun finner gulrøtter, koriander, kål og: She finds carrots, coriander, cabbage and potatoes at the vegetable counter.
sentences.Så går hun til kjøttdisken, men hun finn: Then she goes to the meat counter, but she can't find any lamb.
sentences.Unnskyld, har dere ferskt lammekjøtt?: Excuse me, do you have any fresh lamb?
sentences.Ja, vent litt. Vi har mer på lager. Jeg: Yes, just a moment. We have more in stock. I'll get some for you.
Marit goes on to the ice cream freezer.
There she finds vanilla ice cream.
sentences.Til slutt går hun til kassa for å betale: Finally she goes to the checkout to pay for her shopping.
sentences.Ha en fin dag videre!: Have a nice rest of the day!
sentences.Takk, i like måte, og god helg!: Thanks, you too, and have a good weekend!
Marit comes home with the shopping.
sentences.Det er helt ryddig på kjøkkenet, men Håv: The kitchen is completely tidy, but Håvard has lots of flour in his beard.
sentences.Han gleder seg til å overraske Marit med: He is looking forward to surprising Marit with a big, delicious chocolate cake this evening.
